name: Normal
description: Normal measuring operation. Both thermistors are at their target overheat and the device emits real flow and composition. For the first STABILIZATION_TIME_MS = 60 s after entering this state, flow and comp are forced to exactly 0.0 regardless of the true value; those rows are settling artefacts, not measurements. Flow below 2 L/min is also reported as exactly 0 (firmware deadband). This is the only state in which flow and composition carry information.
led_pattern: blink at 1 Hz with data cadence

name: Initializing
description: Warm-up. Entered on boot and on every wake from sleep. Both thermistors are driven hard to reach setpoint, so measured power is HIGH while the firmware correctly reports zero flow. Derived flow must not be trusted here: the King's-law inverse reads warm-up power as flow (median 0.04 L/min, but 27 L/min at the 90th percentile and 53 at the 99th) on rows where no gas is moving; derive.py drops these rows. Nominal duration WARMUP_DURATION_MS = 50 s.

name: Overtemp
description: A thermistor exceeded MAX_THERMISTOR_TEMP = 70 °C (or fell below MIN_THERMISTOR_TEMP = 0 °C) continuously for 10 s. Heater drive is cut back to protect the element. Not observed in this pilot.

name: Critical Error
description: Unrecoverable fault: a NaN temperature reading, sensor failure, or repeated overtemperature. The system shuts down and does not self-recover. Not observed in this pilot.

name: Temperature Warning
description: A thermistor is drifting outside tolerance (TEMPERATURE_TOLERANCE = 0.3 °C). A 10 s monitoring window runs before escalating to Overtemp. Transient by design. Not observed in this pilot.

name: Sleeping
description: Power-saving sleep, part of the duty cycle enabled by SLEEP_WAKE_MODE. Entered after NO_FLOW_TIMEOUT_MS = 30 s without flow above FLOW_THRESHOLD = 2.5 L/min; lasts SLEEP_DURATION_MS = 220 s before waking into Initializing. Thermistor power is near zero, so derived flow is correctly ~0, but composition is meaningless. This is the most common state in the dataset.

name: Low Voltage
description: Supply fell below VSYS_LOW_THRESHOLD = 2.9 V. Thermistors are switched off and the device waits for recovery above VSYS_RECOVERY_THRESHOLD = 3.0 V, then returns to its previous state. Rare in this pilot: 866 rows on SN_01004 (291), SN_01012 (473) and SN_01013 (102); low-battery shutdown events also appear in the raw msg column.
